project_type: New Build / TI / Change of Use / As-Built
manual_scope: Perform site visit, review existing conditions, prepare concept options, develop permit-ready drawings, and coordinate a single round of plan check comments.

project_intake_subtasks: Review client request and project goals
as_built_subtasks: Review site context and existing conditions
Conduct field verification and initial site visit
site_eval_subtasks: Verify dimensions and constraints in the field
Document site conditions and access issues
Plan for additional site visits if needed
schematic_subtasks: Develop concept studies and massing options
Prepare schematic floor plans and elevations
Refine design direction with client feedback
design_dev_subtasks: Coordinate with consultants on key design issues
cds_subtasks: Prepare drawings for plan check submission
Coordinate drawing package details and schedules
permit_subtasks: Review plan check comments and corrections
Coordinate permitting support and RTI readiness
